name: Tomato
notes: Prefers well-drained loam; sensitive to waterlogging and high EC.

name: Wheat
notes: Tolerant of a fairly wide pH band; responds well to split N application.

name: Rice (Paddy)
notes: Tolerates lower pH; needs standing water for most of the season.

name: Cotton
notes: Reasonably tolerant of moderate salinity/EC compared with vegetables.

name: Soybean
notes: Legume - fixes its own nitrogen, so lower N requirement than cereals.

name: Onion
notes: Sensitive to high EC/salinity; prefers organic-carbon-rich soils.

name: Sugarcane
notes: Long-duration, heavy feeder crop; needs sustained irrigation.

name: Chickpea (Gram)
notes: Legume; performs poorly with excess nitrogen fertilizer.
